Jarhead listens so you can talk to it. Audio goes to the voice model only while a session is open; asleep, nothing leaves this Mac.
Jarhead listens for its wake word with on-device speech recognition while it is asleep. Nothing is sent anywhere until you authenticate.
Jarhead drives other apps to do what you ask: the browser, Finder, System Events. Only while you are talking to it.
Jarhead needs accessibility access to move the cursor, click, and type for you.
Jarhead looks through the camera only when you ask it to. Nothing is recorded or kept.
Jarhead reads Contacts only when you ask for a name or an address.
